answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure onyx-like hardness of identity cloning. By anchoring reputation scores within a karst topology of commitments, agents are incentivized to maintain unique identities, while vault-like accumulators safeguard against replay attacks, yielding information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance, thereby rendering identity spoofing computationally infeasible.
